newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fairwood issues 142 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Fairwood issues 142 million shares.

text.p: Fairwood Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it would issue 142 million shares to its controlling shareholder, which has placed the same number of existing shares to independent invetors at HK$0.38 per share.

The fast food chain said it will issue the shares at about HK$0.376 each to Neblett Investments Ltd. Following completion of the placement and issue, Neblett will continue to hold 371.31 million Fairwood shares representing a 43.49 percent stake.
The placement represents about 19.95 percent of the existing issued share capital and 16.63 percent of the enlarged share capital, it said.
Net proceeds of HK$53.4 million receivable by Fairwood would be used to open new fast food outlets and to expand its institutional catering business in Hong Kong, it said.
